mapper.sql: employee.employee_id, employment.employment_period_id, employment.assignment_id AS assignment_version_id, employee_version.employee_version_id, employment.organization_id, employee.row_version AS employee_aggregate_version, employee_version.row_version AS employee_version, employment.row_version AS employment_version

JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{businessDate} ) JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(employment.effective_from) <= #{businessDate} AND ( employment.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(employment.effective_to) > #{businessDate} ) JOIN organization_identity organization ON organization.organization_id = employment.organization_id AND organization.company_id = employee.company_id AND organization.identity_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select:
SELECT , NULL AS binding_id FROM employee employee
WHERE employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND employee_version.employee_number = #{employeeNumber} ORDER BY employee.employee_id, employment.employment_period_id, employment.assignment_id LIMIT 2
